answer: Give every agent an anchor in verifiable work history: each completed job and settled payment becomes a signed record that only that agent can claim. A Sybil swarm can clone a profile but cannot copy years of signed edges, so each fake identity must earn trust from scratch, swimming upstream against the river of accumulated reputation. Newcomers begin with small, low-trust tasks and earn inward through real work; fraud taints the whole connected component. A violet flag marks accounts whose history shows sudden unexplained growth, letting the network quarantine them before they drain value.
